title: Band at Evan Thomas's murder, the trial, and later Manny's job
summary: Lewis names the band members when the bandleader was killed, recalls testifying at the trial and the escape of the killer, then talks about where he lived in New Orleans, the move to New York in 1945, and how he got the job at Manny's.
